node.statement: Uniform square estimate from the registered H-CB/extended-C*-algebra definitions: there are universal K_sq<infinity and e_sq>0 such that, for every permitted datum with e<=e_sq, every n>=1, and every Z in M_n tensor S_P, ||Z^dagger dot Z|| >= (1-K_sq e)||Z||^2.
